note: This file is a MMSegmentation configuration file containing only variable assignments and dict literals. It has no functions, classes, or callable APIs. It is consumed by the MMSegmentation config system to define model architecture, optimizer, dataset, and training hyperparameters for human parsing on the CIHP dataset using the Sapiens 0.3B vision transformer.
summary: Configuration for sapiens_0.3b model fine-tuned on CIHP dataset at 1024x768 resolution. Defines: EncoderDecoder model with mmpretrain.VisionTransformer backbone, VitHead decode head, AdamW optimizer with layer decay, CIHP train/val dataloaders, and 400-epoch training schedule with PolyLR.
